csv_project_name: PM/CM For Airside 2 Wing Expansion Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Aviation Authority is seeking to engage a qualified Program Management and Construction Management (PMCM) Services Consultant to be responsible for management and oversight of the Airside 2 Wing Expansion Program. The Aviation Authority intends to deliver an aircraft gate expansion at Orlando International Airport (MCO) through the construction of Airside 2 Wing 8, related enabling work, and associated apron and airfield improvements. The Program will provide up to nine additional Narrowbody Equivalent Gates (NBEGs) and relocate two existing gates to support near- and mid-term airline demand while maintaining operational continuity within the existing Airside 2.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
